svg.title: Perpetual — Architecture
svg.desc: Perpetual planned architecture (Specification Revision 4): AWS APIs, Terraform/Kubernetes infrastructure code, and observed evidence feed a local deterministic pipeline (Discover and normalize, Dependency graph with user overrides, Assess and simulate with DR rule packs and two-pass simulator, Recovery plan and DR design producing a digest-bound DR Spec, Compile IaC and recovery artifacts in an isolated worktree, and 4-stage verification on planned snapshots). Opt-in v0.2 LangGraph LLM agents assist with advisory review, candidate planning, and IaC transformation using a local knowledge base, versioned skills, and sanitized web search.
svg.text: Discover → Assess → Plan → Compile & verify fixes
The deterministic engine owns calculated numbers, states and readiness verdicts.
Check planned snapshot (re-assess + re-simulate; strip stale live proof)
Never sends state, secrets, env values or raw logs
Code & artifacts only — isolated worktree sandbox, no infrastructure apply, merge or automatic failover.
